how: Per component the match of the live component against the board that draws its specimen, from the COMP lane TSV (scripts/screens/component_status.py). A component without a row is not measured yet.

CnActionsMenu.name: CnActionsMenu
CnActionsMenu.notes: matches with comp/CnActionsMenu (neutral secondary trigger, trailingChevron 'Meer ⌄' in detail header)

CnAppNav.name: CnAppNav
CnAppNav.notes: matches with comp/CnAppNav: active wash on the entry so thematiq's accent wash shows; attention count white (was --color-error-text, dark red on red). Was 4.18 raw

CnBreadcrumbs.name: CnBreadcrumbs
CnBreadcrumbs.notes: matches with comp/CnBreadcrumbs: trail drawn as 14px text everywhere (was NcBreadcrumbs' 34px buttons outside the detail header), link crumb primary + underline, current muted. Was 35.06 raw

CnDataTable.name: CnDataTable
CnDataTable.notes: comp/CnDataTable: rows 66/header 48 (was 71/67), 60px selection column, 14px muted header, primary-tint initials; thematiq th opt-out on comp-thematiq/board-look-table-head. Remaining: harness lacks the board's column widths/late-date colours

CnDetailCard.name: CnDetailCard
CnDetailCard.notes: matches with comp/CnDetailCard (board card anatomy wherever a CnDetailCard sits, muted side heading !important vs thematiq h3 colour)

CnDetailGrid.name: CnDetailGrid
CnDetailGrid.notes: matches with comp/CnDetailGrid: board anatomy (plain 13px muted label over 15px/500 value, hairline, line height 1.2) instead of grey accent cards

CnDetailPage.name: CnDetailPage
CnDetailPage.notes: header band; remaining diff is the buildiq edit square and inline actions not configured in the harness, not the component

CnNextStepCard.name: CnNextStepCard
CnNextStepCard.notes: matches with comp/CnNextStepCard (normal line height, kicker tone !important, muted step ink, button text padding)

CnQuickFilterBar.name: CnQuickFilterBar
CnQuickFilterBar.notes: selected chip ink + count bubble (comp/CnQuickFilterBar), shape via thematiq #1338; remaining ~1-2px chip width

CnStatusBadge.name: CnStatusBadge
CnStatusBadge.notes: matches with comp/CnStatusBadge: pill ink handed to --nldesign-color-on-surface (thematiq forced near-black text), board pill size 13px/600, 3px 10px. Was 33.55 raw

CnTabs.name: CnTabs
CnTabs.notes: matches with comp/CnTabs (core button margin zeroed, tabs bottom-aligned, Acties 8px clear) + thematiq #1338

CnTimelineStages.name: CnTimelineStages
CnTimelineStages.notes: matches with comp/CnStagesWidget (bars flush, normal line height, muted open steps); measured through CnStagesWidget bars
